summary_en: 5,000,000 shares (4.5% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), up to ¥6,000M, ceiling price not disclosed, ToSTNeT-3 (open-market via Tokyo Stock Exchange trading agreement), execution Aug 10, 2026–Mar 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice of determination of matters relating to acquisition of treasury shares (Acquisition of treasury shares pursuant to articles of incorporation under Company Law article 165(2))
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2026, Japan Pulp and Paper Company's board authorized a share buyback program under Company Law article 156 (as applied via article 165(3)). The filer will acquire up to 5,000,000 ordinary shares (4.5% of the 112,266,546 shares outstanding excluding treasury as of 30 June 2026) for an aggregate consideration not to exceed ¥6,000M. The shares will be acquired via open-market trading (ToSTNeT-3) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from 10 August 2026 through 31 March 2027. The filer stated that the buyback supports its policy to execute proactive shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency under its OVOL mid-term business plan for FY3/27.
